hero.zh: 一个主语，连续长成一套系统。
hero.en: One subject continuously becomes a system.

intro.zh: 主语不被替换。尺度、密度与关系持续变化，最后把阅读主导权交还给普通文档。
intro.en: The subject is never replaced. Scale, density, and relationships change continuously before ordinary reading takes over.

body.zh: 低密度画面只建立材质、轮廓与首要行动。
body.en: A low-density field establishes material, silhouette, and the primary action.

title.zh: 主语展开为十二个工作模块。
title.en: The subject unfolds into twelve working modules.

body.zh: 所有模块共享一个来源，却用位置和颜色解释不同职责。
body.en: Every module shares one origin while position and color explain distinct roles.

title.zh: 空间收束，规格进入文档。

body.zh: 沉浸舞台完成解释后主动退出，不长期占用信息阅读。
body.en: The immersive stage exits after explanation instead of occupying the entire document.

note.zh: 单位体积的有效覆盖率
反向路径可恢复的状态
由同一主语释放的功能模块
note.en: Functional modules released by one subject
